title: Travel: John Lennon – Barcelona to Nice | 1971
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono travelled from Barcelona in Spain and returned to Nice, France, on 18 May 1971.

They had been in Cannes on the French Riviera for the premieres of their films Fly and Apotheosis, and to attend the Cannes Film Festival, but travelled to Barcelona on 17 May for consultations with their Spanish lawyers regarding a potential case to win custody of Kyoko, Ono’s seven-year-old daughter.

They spent several days in the French Riviera before returning to London on 22 May.
